prompt.en-US: Answer in three or four sentences.

question.zh-CN: 为什么评测一个新模型时一定要明确“和谁比、为了什么决策”？
question.en-US: Why must an eval of a new model state what it is compared against and which decision it informs?

description.zh-CN: 指出评测结论服务于具体决策（上线、替换、继续训练）
description.en-US: Says the result serves a concrete decision (launch, replace, keep training)

description.zh-CN: 指出需要和现网或强基线在同一数据上比较
description.en-US: Says it must be compared with production or a strong baseline on the same data

description.zh-CN: 提到评测分布要匹配决策影响的流量
description.en-US: Mentions matching the eval distribution to the traffic the decision affects

modelAnswer.zh-CN: 没有决策，评测分数无法解读；没有基线，分数没有参照。替换现网的决策要求和现网模型在真实流量分布上比较，分数差才有意义。
modelAnswer.en-US: Without a decision a score cannot be interpreted; without a baseline it has no reference. A replacement decision requires comparing against the production model on the real traffic distribution.

explanation.zh-CN: 这是所有 eval 设计题的第一步。
explanation.en-US: This is the first step of every eval design question.
